thread.title: Needham & Company LLC Increases Apple (AAPL) Price Target to $260.00

author: Chris Copeland
title: Needham & Company LLC Increases Apple (AAPL) Price Target to $260.00
text:
Tweet
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its price target increased by investment analysts at Needham & Company LLC from $220.00 to $260.00 in a research report issued on Thursday, Marketbeat.com reports. The brokerage currently has a “buy” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. Needham & Company LLC’s price target indicates a potential upside of 16.15% from the stock’s previous close.
A number of other analysts have also recently weighed in on the company. UBS Group began coverage on Apple in a research report on Wednesday. Macquarie set a $214.00 price target on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Wednesday. BidaskClub cut Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating in a research report on Wednesday. Royal Bank of Canada reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $240.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday. Finally, S&P Equity Research upped their price target on Apple to $250.00 and gave the company an “in-line” rating in a research report on Tuesday. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating and thirty have issued a buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $217.53. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of NASDAQ AAPL opened at $223.84 on Thursday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a current ratio of 1.31 and a quick ratio of 1.24. The firm has a market capitalization of $1,086.59 billion, a P/E ratio of 24.54, a PEG ratio of 1.95 and a beta of 1.33. Apple has a one year low of $149.16 and a one year high of $229.67. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The firm had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $52.43 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the business posted $1.67 earnings per share. The business’s revenue was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. equities analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.74 EPS for the current year.
In related news, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 15,652 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, July 9th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.18, for a total value of $2,976,697.36. Following the transaction, the chief operating officer now owns 125,258 shares in the company, valued at $23,821,566.44. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is available through this hyperlink . Also, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, August 27th. The shares were sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total value of $57,749,196.40. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last quarter, insiders sold 378,400 shares of company stock worth $81,052,754. 0.08% of the stock is owned by company insiders.
Institutional investors have recently bought and sold shares of the stock. Fort L.P. acquired a new position in Apple in the second quarter valued at about $119,000. Delphi Private Advisors LLC acquired a new position in Apple in the second quarter valued at about $120,000. Cranbrook Wealth Management LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 76.1% in the second quarter. Cranbrook Wealth Management LLC now owns 699 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $129,000 after buying an additional 302 shares during the period. Brand Asset Management Group Inc. acquired a new position in Apple in the second quarter valued at about $134,000. Finally, Quattro Financial Advisors LLC acquired a new position in Apple in the first quarter valued at about $133,000. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 58.62% of the company’s stock.
